scenario: A humanitarian NGO compares two convoy-planning methods across plain terrain, forest corridors, and mountain roads. Directors prefer Method A because its overall aid-delivery success rate is much higher.

data.description: Delivery success by terrain and method.

question: (a) Which method performs better in each terrain type? (b) If the target corridor mix is 30% plains, 40% forest, and 30% mountain roads, compute the corrected success rate for each method. (c) Which method should be preferred?

ground_truth.explanation: Method B is stronger in every terrain class, but Method A served a much easier corridor mix.

naive_answer: Method A is better because its aggregate delivery success is higher.
naive_trap: Terrain mix, not method quality, drives the aggregate advantage.
